messages.quest.field_medicine.night_ward.descript: Help the village prepare medicine and proof against the wounds that arrive after sunset.
messages.quest.field_medicine.night_ward.scene.ni: The ward is quiet again. Gather six samples from the dead before the evidence spoils.
The ward doors are barred. Three dead are pushing in from the dark-meet them outside.
quest.field_medicine.night_ward.stage.cl: Bandages are useful after a wound. A good ward tries to meet trouble before the door breaks.
Clear the dead that press too close and bring samples. Then we will make the stronger medicine no one asks about politely.
messages.quest.field_medicine.night_ward.stage.cl: I will keep the ward quiet.
quest.field_medicine.night_ward.stage.cl: Zombies do not wait for clean rooms. Thin them out and bring the samples.
messages.quest.field_medicine.night_ward.stage.cl: Bring 6 rotten flesh samples so the ward knows what bit first.
Defeat 3 zombies before they become patients or memories.
quest.field_medicine.night_ward.stage.cl: Then light a window if you pass one. It is not nothing.
Come back before your own hands need wrapping.
Defeat 3 zombies and bring 6 rotten flesh samples for the night ward.
The sickroom is not ready for that work right now.
The night ward is already stocked and written down.
Defeat 3 zombies and bring 6 rotten flesh. Grim counting, but useful counting.
The ward is not ready to ask this of you right now.
messages.quest.field_medicine.night_ward.stage.cl: Defeat 3 zombies and bring 6 rotten flesh.
quest.field_medicine.night_ward.stage.re: This is enough for a bad night to become a story instead of a grave.
Good. I hope the ward gathers dust. Preparing for pain does not mean inviting it in.
The ward still needs its patrol cleared or its apple and sugar before we lock the chest.
Bring the ward supplies here so I can set them aside.
I cannot close the night ward right now.
The chest stays open until the list is finished.
messages.quest.field_medicine.night_ward.stage.re: Return with the night ward supplies.
quest.field_medicine.night_ward.stage.st: Now the ward needs medicine with a little hope in it. Bring a golden apple and sugar.
messages.quest.field_medicine.night_ward.stage.st: Bring 1 golden apple for the ward chest.
Bring 8 sugar for harsh medicine that goes down easier.
quest.field_medicine.night_ward.stage.st: The best cure is the one no one needs today.
Bring 1 golden apple and 8 sugar for the night ward chest.
The stronger medicine can wait until the sickroom is clear.
messages.quest.field_medicine.night_ward.title: The Night Ward
